newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Megacor to list, predicts profit rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Megacor to list, predicts profit rise.

text.p: South African investment holding company Megacor Holdings Ltd said on it would list its shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange with effect from Tuesday and predicted higher earnings in 1997.

The group, which has subsidiaries with interests in construction and furniture, said it expected revenue to rise to 230.27 million rand in 1997 from 167.56 million in 1996 with fully diluted earnings per share set to reach 30.44 cents versus 26.40.
Based on the subscription price of 200 cents per share that would give the company a prospective price/earnings ratio of 6.5 and 7.6 on an historic basis.
Megacor said it expected to pay a dividend of 10.15 cents in 1997 against 8.80 in 1996.
